end.summary:
Aditya identified cylinder and sphere in toy/object examples.
They practised faces and curved sides of cylinders.
They identified a cone by its point in one example.
They repeatedly said a shape’s name changes when it is turned or lying down; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone, and sphere in toys and objects, using faces, curved sides, rolling, and points as clues. Aditya explained that a cylinder has two flat faces and a curved side, and used this reasoning for a candle. The mix-up that turning or filling a shape changes its name was still present at the end. At home, show one object such as a cup or ball in different positions and ask, “Is it still the same shape?”
